create_mol_from_smile: create an RDKit molecule from a SMILES string with generated 3D conformation
build_mol_from_mmcif: build an RDKit molecule from a template mmCIF file with atom positions and bond information
test_reverse_complement: test the reverse complement of a DNA or RNA nucleic acid sequence
generate_conformation_mol: generate a 3D conformation for an RDKit molecule by adding hydrogens, embedding, and removing hydrogens
run_is_unique_check: run an uniqueness check on an array to verify all elements are distinct
